description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing plugin activation states, including normalization, decision-making, and configuration handling within the openclaw project.

methods.name: normalizePluginId
methods.description: Trims and normalizes plugin IDs, resolving aliases from bundled capability metadata.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a normalized list of plugin IDs, applying normalization and filtering.

methods.name: normalizeSlotValue
methods.description: Normalizes slot values, handling 'none' and trimming.

methods.name: resolvePluginActivationReason
methods.description: Resolves the reason string for plugin activation based on cause or explicit reason.

methods.name: toPluginActivationState
methods.description: Converts a PluginActivationDecision object into a PluginActivationState.

methods.name: normalizePluginEntries
methods.description: Normalizes plugin entries from raw configuration data.

methods.name: normalizePluginsConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the plugins configuration object, applying defaults and normalization.

methods.name: createPluginActivationSource
methods.description: Creates a PluginActivationConfigSource from optional config and plugins data.

methods.name: hasExplicitMemorySlot
methods.description: Checks if the plugins configuration explicitly defines a memory slot.

methods.name: hasExplicitMemoryEntry
methods.description: Checks if the plugins configuration explicitly defines a memory-core entry.

methods.name: hasExplicitPluginConfig
methods.description: Determines if the plugins configuration has explicit settings.

methods.name: applyTestPluginDefaults
methods.description: Applies default plugin configuration for testing environments, especially under Vitest.

methods.name: isTestDefaultMemorySlotDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the default memory slot should be disabled in test environments.

methods.name: resolveExplicitPluginSelection
methods.description: Resolves whether a plugin is explicitly enabled and the cause for that decision.

methods.name: resolvePluginActivationState
methods.description: Determines the activation state of a plugin based on configuration, origin, and other factors.

methods.name: resolveEnableState
methods.description: Simplified function to determine if a plugin is enabled, with reason if disabled.

methods.name: isBundledChannelEnabledByChannelConfig
methods.description: Checks if a bundled channel plugin is enabled based on channel configuration.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveEnableState
methods.description: Resolves the effective enable state of a plugin, considering all factors.

methods.name: resolveEffectivePluginActivationState
methods.description: Returns the full activation state of a plugin, considering configuration and context.

methods.name: resolveMemorySlotDecision
methods.description: Decides if a memory plugin slot is enabled, based on plugin kind, slot, and selection.
